title: Tate McRae Stars in Adidas’ New Originals Sport Collection Inspired by the Superstar Tracksuit
summary: Fronted by Tate McRae, Emilia Mernes and Harper Murray, the new Adidas collection brings Superstar-inspired designs to a lineup of performance-ready womenswear essentials.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Fresh off its World Cup spotlight , Adidas is expanding its Originals line with the debut of Originals Sport, a new womenswear collection that blends performance technology with the brand’s signature streetwear style.

Inspired by the iconic Superstar tracksuit, the collection features bras, leggings, tanks, onesies and layering pieces designed for versatile styling beyond the gym. The collection debuted in New York City on July 22 and became available July 23.

The campaign stars Tate McRae , Emilia Mernes and volleyball player Harper Murray, showcasing Adidas’ vision of women who move between sport, music and culture, while the collection updates Adidas Originals signatures, including Trefoil branding and three-stripe details, with feminine silhouettes and performance features like Climacool, AdiSoft and LYCRA Adaptiv.

SPORTY & STYLISH

Adidas Originals Sport Medium Support Bra

$50

Buy Now at adidas

Medium-support bra with Adiflex stretch and removable padding.

Made for workouts and beyond, this Adidas medium-support bra features a streamlined bonded fit, breathable Climacool technology, stretchy Adiflex material and removable padding you can adjust as needed.

BUILT TO MOVE

Adidas Originals Sport Superstar 7/8 Leggings

$70

No-front-seam leggings with CLIMACOOL comfort.

If you’re looking for leggings that can do it all, this Adidas pair checks every box. They combine CLIMACOOL technology for breathable comfort with Adimove 3.0 fabric that feels soft and supportive, while the mid-rise fit offers a sleek look you’ll want to wear long after your workout ends.

WORKOUT READY

Adidas Originals Sport Shorts

$45

Lightweight training shorts with a relaxed fit and built-in mesh brief.

Part of the Adidas Originals Sport collection, these loose-fit shorts are designed for everything from workouts to weekend errands. They feature a comfortable mid-rise waistband with an adjustable drawstring, a built-in mesh brief for added coverage and signature satin 3-Stripes for a sporty finish.

PERFORMANCE PICK

Adidas Originals Sport Onesie

A sleek one-piece essential designed for training and beyond.

Taking activewear beyond the basics, this Adidas Originals Sport onesie combines a sleek silhouette with performance-focused details. The fitted design is made with Adiflex material for flexible support, while CLIMACOOL technology helps wick away sweat for a comfortable feel.

GYM-TO-STREET LAYER

Adidas Originals Sport Coverup

Relaxed half-zip pullover with Trefoil branding and snap-button pockets.

The perfect layer for transitioning from workouts to everyday plans, this Adidas Originals Sport coverup sweatshirt combines a relaxed fit with streetwear-inspired details. The half-zip design, hood and elasticized cuffs make it easy to adjust for comfort, while snap-button pockets keep essentials close and Trefoil branding adds a signature Adidas finish.

McRae’s involvement follows a breakthrough period for the singer, who has evolved from a teenage songwriter uploading music to YouTube into one of pop’s biggest young performers. Her 2020 hit “You Broke Me First” marked her first Billboard Hot 100 appearance, while her dynamic choreography and emotional songwriting have become key parts of her identity as an artist.

The singer recently completed her Miss Possessive arena tour, which grossed $110.8 million, according to Billboard Boxscore, and was named a Billboard Women in Music Hitmaker . She is also preparing new music and will headline Chicago’s Lollapalooza this summer.

Mernes joins McRae following her own rise in Latin pop . The Argentine artist launched her solo career with “Recalienta” in 2019 before releasing her debut album Tú crees en mí? (“Do you believe in me?”) in 2022 through Sony Music Latin. The eight-track project, which includes collaborations with Tiago PZK and Duki, helped solidify Mernes’ place in the music industry.

The Adidas Originals Sport collection is available online and in retail stores, with prices ranging from $45 to $70.
